title: Deep learning approaches for noncoding variant prioritization in neurodegenerative diseases.
authors: Lan, Alexander Y; Corces, M Ryan
one_liner_zh: 综述深度学习在神经退行性疾病非编码变异优先级排序中的应用，涉及转录因子结合预测，但非核心TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象偏疾病基因组学。
abstract: Determining how noncoding genetic variants contribute to neurodegenerative dementias is fundamental to understanding disease pathogenesis, improving patient prognostication, and developing new clinical treatments. Next generation sequencing technologies have produced vast amounts of genomic data on cell type-specific transcription factor binding, gene expression, and three-dimensional chromatin interactions, with the promise of providing key insights into the biological mechanisms underlying disease. However, this data is highly complex, making it challenging for researchers to interpret, assimilate, and dissect. To this end, deep learning has emerged as a powerful tool for genome analysis that can capture the intricate patterns and dependencies within these large datasets. In this review, we organize and discuss the many unique model architectures, development philosophies, and interpretation methods that have emerged in the last few years with a focus on using deep learning to predict the impact of genetic variants on disease pathogenesis. We highlight both broadly-applicable genomic deep learning methods that can be fine-tuned to disease-specific contexts as well as existing neurodegenerative disease research, with an emphasis on Alzheimer's-specific literature. We conclude with an overview of the future of the field at the intersection of neurodegeneration, genomics, and deep learning.
abstract_zh: 确定非编码遗传变异如何导致神经退行性痴呆，对于理解疾病发病机制、改善患者预后评估以及开发新的临床治疗方法至关重要。下一代测序技术已产生了大量关于细胞类型特异性转录因子结合、基因表达和三维染色质相互作用的基因组数据，有望为疾病背后的生物学机制提供关键见解。然而，这些数据高度复杂，使研究人员难以解读、整合和剖析。为此，深度学习已成为基因组分析的有力工具，能够捕捉这些大型数据集中的复杂模式和依赖关系。在本综述中，我们整理并讨论了近年来出现的多种独特模型架构、开发理念和解释方法，重点关注利用深度学习预测遗传变异对疾病发病机制的影响。我们强调了既可广泛应用的基因组深度学习方法（可微调至疾病特定情境）以及现有的神经退行性疾病研究，特别聚焦于阿尔茨海默病相关文献。最后，我们概述了该领域在神经退行性、基因组学和深度学习交叉点的未来发展方向。
